svg.title: DIA-201 · The bar, lowered
svg.desc: A stippled ink drawing of a high-jump pit seen from the run-up at three-quarter view, in the manner of an old athletics coaching manual. Two tall standards with rows of peg holes stand in front of a low sand pit. High on each standard a painted band and a ghost of the bar in broken outline show where the bar used to rest, labelled September 2023: pause if capability outruns control. The crossbar, drawn in rust, now rests on pegs in the lowest holes, barely above the ground and still quivering, labelled February 2026: no pause. The two old pegs lie dropped on the grass beside the near standard.
svg.text: September 2023: pause if capability outruns control
Four revisions since, to July 2026. The bar has not gone back up.
DIA-201 · A standard set by the one who must clear it is set where it can be cleared.
